contamination_assessment: The quantity predicted is 'what the official evaluation will report for these models'. No official per-model score for CASP17 was public or seen when these tables were computed. Before freezing we looked at the distributions of our own scores and cross-checked six models of T2409 against two independent libraries (TM-align via tmtools, lDDT via biotite); no change was made to the code afterwards. Not controlled and stated: the official evaluation units (domains, trimmed residues, reference chain) are unknown to us; the comparison plan says how that is handled.

exclusions.item: all other CASP17 targets with a released reference (complexes, RNA, the 1142-residue ligand complex, the 17-residue peptide)
exclusions.reason: they need interface, nucleic-acid or oligomer scores that this code does not implement; scoring them with CA-based monomer scores would not correspond to the official evaluation

exclusions.item: accuracy-estimation, ligand and ensemble submissions for the same targets
exclusions.reason: not structure models scored by these metrics

notes: One row per public model file; no model was dropped. Models that lack residues are scored with the missing residues counted as not superposed (columns ca_common_*).

protocol.id: FB-P-10; comparison plan COMPARISON_PLAN.md in this freeze

reference_status.statement: The reference structures are released PDB entries. What is not public at freeze time is the official CASP17 numerical evaluation: the results page said 'No results available yet' on 2026-11-26 (freeze FRONTIER-FRZ-0001) and the organisers announced the results for 2026-11-29. The class is therefore pre-leaderboard (A-PLB), with respect to the official per-model scores only.

title: Scores computed by this division's own code for every public CASP17 model of targets T2409, T2410 and T2411 against the released PDB references, frozen before the official CASP17 numbers exist; a blind check of the scoring code, not of any MetricChain method
